name: browser-code
description: A browser window beside two complete code chevrons.
useCase: Open the current page source or browser developer tools.
misuse: Use a visible label to identify the specific browser action or page state.

16.reason: A solid control pill stays visible at text size, with clear gaps to the address hint and window outline.

24.reason: The circular window control sits on the pixel grid and stays separate from the address hint.
